title: feat(shop_operations): collision-safe ids and material provenance (SHOP-OP-RECORD-HARDEN-002)
intent: Harden the merged SHOP-OP-RECORD-001 file-per-event record in place. Add a collision-safe default record id, require measurement provenance on newly written material lines, document the unit token rule and the authority boundary, and prove the package does not import CAM, readiness, G-code, or estimate code. Do not add verified job references, routes, or a second record model.
behavior_change: New material lines written through make_operation_record or FileShopOperationRepository.save require measurement provenance. Historical three-field material lines still load and re-save when the bytes are unchanged. make_operation_record can omit record_id and receive sop_{milliseconds}_{uuid4 hex}. Schema id and version are unchanged.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Default record ids use the MAINT-DEFER-019 millisecond-plus-uuid shape while caller-supplied ids remain valid. MaterialUsage gains optional provenance fields that canonical JSON omits when absent, so pre-harden files keep their digest. New writes require MANUAL_MEASUREMENT, SCALE_READING, COUNTED, or IMPORTED_MEASUREMENT, plus recorder, observation time, and a source reference for imports. AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY.md and structural import tests record the non-authority boundary. No schema id change, no route.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: PR #464 is the canonical operation record. This increment does not add a second aggregate. It closes three gaps on that record: caller-only ids, material lines with no measurement provenance, and a missing authority-boundary document. Verified job references stay deferred to SHOP-JOB-REFERENCE-RESOLVER-001.
